tools.name: devices
tools.description: List every iOS simulator and Android emulator on this worktree's worker with its id, OS, model and whether it is on, and which one the Simulator tab has focused. Band creates no device on its own.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show one device's id, platform, whether it is on and its screen size. Android sizes are pixels, iOS sizes are points. Acts on the device named by `device`, else on the device in the last focused pane of the Simulator tab; with neither, answers with the list of devices. Turns nothing on.

device.description: Device id or name from simulator_devices. Without it the tool acts on the device in the pane of the Simulator tab that was focused last.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Show a simulator or emulator in this worktree's Simulator tab. Run your app with your own tools (xcrun simctl, xcodebuild, expo, adb, Maestro). After you boot a simulator or emulator, or install or launch an app on one, call simulator_show with its UDID or adb serial so the person sees the device you used. Find the id with `xcrun simctl list devices booted` or `adb devices`, or from simulator_devices. From a shell: `band tools call simulator_show --json '{"device":"<id>"}'`. The device goes in the pane focused last (else the first pane), and an open tab switches to it without a reload. The answer says which pane. An unknown device is an error that lists the devices.

device.description: Device id (iOS UDID, Android adb serial like emulator-5554, or an id from simulator_devices) or its name.
